Agentic harness.d: The software layer around an AI model that gives it tools, manages what it sees (its context) and enforces permissions. Claude Code is the agentic harness around Claude models.

Workspace trust.d: The question Claude Code asks the first time you start it in a folder: whether you trust that folder's own settings, hooks and MCP servers, which can run commands.

Working directory.d: The folder a program is working in. For Claude Code, the folder you start it in: it can read there freely and asks before going outside it.

Checkpoint.d: A snapshot Claude Code saves before editing files, so you can rewind its changes later. It doesn't cover changes made by shell commands or to external systems.

Compaction.d: Replacing a long conversation with a summary to free up space in the context window. Claude Code does it automatically near the limit, or when you run /compact.

Auto mode classifier.d: In Claude Code's Auto permission mode, a second AI model that reviews actions not covered by your rules and blocks risky ones instead of asking you.

Tool call.d: A request from an AI model to use one of its tools, such as reading a file or running a command, with the inputs filled in. The surrounding app runs it and returns the result.
